description: This file defines the ReadableProduct class, which extends ProductEntity and implements Serializable. It serves as a data transfer object representing a product with descriptive attributes, pricing, images, manufacturer, and attributes within an e-commerce application.

classes.name: ReadableProduct
classes.description: A serializable data transfer object representing a product with descriptive and multimedia attributes, pricing details, manufacturer info, and product attributes.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the final sale price of the product.

methods.name: setFinalPrice
methods.description: Sets the final sale price of the product.

methods.name: getOriginalPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the original (non-discounted) price of the product.

methods.name: isDiscounted
methods.description: Checks if the product is discounted.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Returns the list of images associated with the product.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves the primary image of the product.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the list of product attributes.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Returns the manufacturer information for the product.
